name: Joseph
bio: Joseph, a descendant of David, was engaged to Mary when he discovered she was pregnant before they had come together. Being a righteous man unwilling to publicly shame her, he planned to quietly end the engagement, until an angel appeared to him in a dream explaining that Mary's child was conceived by the Holy Spirit and instructing him to name the baby Jesus, for he would save his people from their sins. Joseph obeyed, took Mary as his wife, and did not consummate the marriage until after Jesus was born (Matthew 1:18-25). His continued role protecting the family is told in detail in the chapters ahead. When wise men came seeking the newborn king, Herod the Great plotted to kill him; warned by an angel in a dream, Joseph fled with Mary and Jesus to Egypt, staying until Herod's death, then settled the family in Nazareth rather than Judea out of fear of Herod's son Archelaus (Matthew 2:1-23).
